title: WS-007 - Invitations API overview
intent: Explain what the Invitations API is used for and which privilege it requires.
short_answer: The Invitations API allows an authenticated system user to create token lists, generate tokens, activate or deactivate tokens, delete tokens, retrieve asynchronous token-generation results, and turn a submitted contribution back into draft state. These operations require Form Management read/write access on the survey.
procedure: Grant the system user Form Management RW on the survey.
Create a token list with createNewTokenList.
Generate tokens with createTokens and retrieve them with getResults.
Use activateToken, deactivateToken, or deleteToken for token lifecycle management.
important_conditions: Token generation is asynchronous because it can be computationally demanding.
Generated token data can only be downloaded by the user that requested it.
